description: Returns the most recent status changes for a business, newest first, each with the status, note, and time. Useful for 'when did it close?' or 'how often does this change?'.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

name: get_status_history
title: Get a business's recent status changes
